description: This PHP class defines a custom form type 'LocationType' for Symfony framework, handling location input with configurable options, view transformation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: LocationType
classes.description: Custom Symfony form type for handling location input with options for map radius, address fields, and geocoding attributes.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type, including location-related parameters.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form fields and view transformer based on options and location object.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Prepares variables for rendering the form view, including location object and radius.

methods.name: finishView
methods.description: Finalizes the form view, adding data attributes for geocoding and CSS classes.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix 'location' for form theming.
